question: If in a coding system EDEKA is coded as 54521, then how will AORBG be coded in the same coding system?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] Logic : • Position value according to the English alphabetic series is written. • Double digit position values are made single digits by adding digits within the number.
